selection_policy.crop_policy: Use the full photograph when the object kind is unambiguous. Crop only when focus would otherwise be ambiguous and the crop preserves every operand needed by the teaching claim.
selection_policy.result: Twenty registry photographs pass as full frames. Four unsafe hard-tail slots use complete deterministic panel extractions from one purpose-made reference board because registry alternatives repeatedly contained competing frontier objects, text, or utensil bleed.

derived_master.purpose: purpose-made four-panel hard-tail reference board for two cups, one bowl, and one spoon
derived_master.pixel_review: Exact full-resolution inspection confirms one complete text-free object per panel: handled cup, handled cup, deep bowl, metal spoon; no people, food, other tableware, labels, logos, or watermarks.
derived_master.prompt: Create a clean 2 by 2 instructional reference board with two text-free handled cups, one empty deep bowl, and one fully visible metal spoon, exactly one object kind per equal panel on plain light-gray studio backgrounds; no saucers, plates, forks, other utensils, people, food, liquid, captions, logos, numbers, arrows, or watermarks.
